'''Squad Seven''' was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]]. As part of the garnison on the [[Sun Razer]] station, they were dispatched with others units to [[Mission to the Vesla system|deal]] with intruders&mdash;[[Teff'ith]] and [[Ngani Zho]]. The latter died in the ensuing firefight.
